query: A private Supabase module receives Postgres unique-violation code 23505 while createProject runs. Show where that error is translated for both a Server Action and a Route Handler without exposing the database message.
baseline_failure: RED hypothesis: the private server module throws an HTTP-oriented ApiError, or the application operation imports a Response/framework error class, coupling application behavior to one runtime channel.
expected_behavior: Maps the known database code in the capability's private server adapter to a transport-neutral application error such as ConflictError
Keeps the raw Postgres payload only in private server diagnostic context and throws a clean ConflictError without the provider error as cause
Keeps one application failure classification, then translates it per native surface: a serializable result for actions.ts and an HTTP status plus envelope for the Route Handler
Makes every projects-module import in the app/** Route Handler come from modules/projects/server.ts, including its public failure classifier
anti_expectation: Does NOT expose error.message, SQL details, or PostgREST payloads to the client
Does NOT make domain/ or application/ depend on ApiError, Response, Next.js, or route status codes
Does NOT let app/** bypass the projects root public surface to call private composition or import application errors
Does NOT carry the raw provider payload out of the private adapter as Error.cause
